name: vue-mfe-vite
description: Vue 3 + Vite 7 micro-frontend monorepo (host + shell-a + shell-b) using Module Federation

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mfe/shell-a && npm run build -w @mfe/shell-b && npm run build -w @mfe/host
scripts.build:staging: npm run build:staging -w @mfe/shell-a && npm run build:staging -w @mfe/shell-b && npm run build:staging -w @mfe/host
scripts.build:localprod: npm run build:localprod -w @mfe/shell-a && npm run build:localprod -w @mfe/shell-b && npm run build:localprod -w @mfe/host
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n host,shell-a,shell-b -c blue,green,magenta "npm run preview -w @mfe/host" "npm run preview -w @mfe/shell-a" "npm run preview -w @mfe/shell-b"
scripts.start: npm run build:localprod && npm run preview
